name: realm-hack
description: Monorepo workspace for realm-hack: client (app), gateway (app), and server

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.sync:android: cd client && npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:android: cd client && npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.open:android: cd client && npx cap open android
